_help: Find the Exception: operational review thresholds, not proof of safety.
on_ezio_failure_why: Missing upstream evidence cannot authorize sending; known company-policy contradictions still require BLOCK.
tier_decisions_why: GREEN clears only the aggregate check, YELLOW needs human review, and RED withholds sending; independent contradictions and poor dimensions can always raise the decision.

tone.why: Customer correspondence should be neutral rather than promotional; tone below 80 requires a human rewrite before sending.

bias.why: One-sided customer guidance can mislead even with correct prices, so framing below 80 requires review.

agreement.why: Support should independently check the customer's premise rather than flatter or over-agree; agreement below 80 requires review.

when_accuracy_not_scored_why: No claims scored is not a contradiction: routine correspondence can pass, while company claims remain subject to independent policy checks.
when_accuracy_unavailable_why: An unavailable fact-checker leaves public claims unchecked, so hold unless an independent contradiction already requires BLOCK.
